nodes.label: GitHub Copilot Instructions (Bitfocus Companion Module v4+)
nodes.rationale: Mandates English-only content and a strict, lifecycle-safe, dependency-minimal coding style so generated code is mergeable into the official Bitfocus Companion repo without further discussion by core maintainers.

nodes.label: Pre-Commit / CI Review Prompt
nodes.rationale: Defines a sequential, no-judgment-before-full-analysis review process (folder analysis, architecture, API/lifecycle, code quality, dependencies, manifest, UX) performed in the persona of a Bitfocus Companion core maintainer before allowing a commit.

nodes.label: Companion Module Review (Core) PR Template
nodes.rationale: Structured PR review template covering structure, lifecycle, code quality, dependencies, actions/feedbacks/variables, documentation, blockers, and merge decision, mirroring the core-maintainer review persona.

nodes.label: Release on Version Change Workflow
nodes.rationale: Automatically creates a GitHub release with a built .tgz only when package.json version differs from the latest release tag, avoiding duplicate releases.

nodes.label: Bitfocus Companion Module Release Checklist
nodes.rationale: Checklist may only be completed after a full analysis of the entire project folder; covers structure, API/lifecycle, code quality, dependencies/licenses, manifest/metadata, actions/feedbacks/variables, and documentation before declaring the module release-ready ('Releasefähig nur bei vollständig erfüllter Checkliste').

nodes.label: Waves SuperRack Router Inline Help
nodes.rationale: Explains the Waves 'Hot Plugin/Hot Snapshot' workaround needed because Waves SuperRack has no native MIDI rack-selection support.
